sourceNotes.rawContent:
- Bring a touch of elegance and sparkle to your everyday style with these stunning gold-plated pink crystal flower stud earrings. Featuring six faceted petal stones in a soft pastel pink shade and a brilliant crystal center, these earrings radiate feminine charm and sophistication.
- The gold-detailed edges enhance the luxurious look, making them perfect for both casual outings and festive occasions. Lightweight and comfortable, these floral studs pair beautifully with Western, Indo-western, and traditional outfits, adding a subtle yet eye-catching glow.
- Keywords included: pink flower earrings, gold-plated crystal studs, floral earrings for women, pastel pink stone earrings, lightweight daily wear jewelry, festive stud earrings.
